ios.notes:
Duotone for iPhone 5.9.4

Fixed
- Messages, friends' status and what they're playing keep arriving live when Duotone has been open for a long time. If the server drops the live connection, Duotone reconnects by itself.

Minimum version: 5.9.4

Full changelog: https://github.com/joaoafonso2004/duotone/compare/ios-v5.9.3...ios-v5.9.4

windows.notes:
Duotone for Windows 5.9.4

Fixed
- After Duotone had been open for a long time, or the computer woke from sleep, messages and live updates could stop arriving, and the app checked the server every minute instead. It now keeps the live connection and reconnects by itself. Much lighter on the server.

Minimum version: 5.9.4

Full changelog: https://github.com/joaoafonso2004/duotone/compare/win-v5.9.3...win-v5.9.4
